title: HB1381 (2017-2018 Regular): Increasing reciprocity for concealed pistol licenses.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States public data converted to LegiScan layout (gun-policy Stage 5, Washington); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Washington Legislature text (Introduced, https://lawfilesext.leg.wa.gov/Biennium/2017-18/Htm/Bills/House%20Bills/1381.htm, downloaded directly)
provenance.note: Introduced version. Bill strikes the requirement that the other state recognize Washington licenses and that it not license persons under 21 (and the (ii) reference in subsection (2)); quoted lines show text after strikes/additions, so (1)(a)(ii) and (1)(b) unchanged and not quoted.

operative_text:
Sec. 1 (RCW 9.41.073(1)(a)): (1)(a) A person licensed to carry a pistol in any other state is authorized to carry a concealed pistol in this state if: (i) The license holder from the other state is not under eighteen years of age; and
Sec. 1 (RCW 9.41.073(2)): (2) The attorney general shall periodically publish a list of states the laws of which meet the requirements of subsection (1)(a) of this section.
